prompt: A contact sheet of six separate food photographs arranged in a strict grid of 3 columns by 2 rows, each subject centred in its own invisible square cell of equal size (cells are 768 by 768 px), on one continuous seamless flat matte warm cream ground (#F4E6C4), with no lines, borders or labels between cells and a generous empty margin (at least 12 percent) around each subject so nothing touches a cell edge. All six shot identically: three-quarter elevated angle (about 40 degrees), soft warm daylight from the upper left, very soft short contact shadow under each item, the same sharp realistic editorial food-photography look, real appetising colours. Crockery: matte deep forest-green (#233929) ceramic, brushed steel. The reference image only shows the look of the bowl, light and food realism: do not copy its composition or ground colour. Cells, left to right, top row then bottom row: (1) chana massala: a green bowl of chickpeas in a rich orange-brown spiced tomato sauce, ginger strips and coriander on top; (2) biryani légumes: a green bowl of golden-saffron and white spiced basmati rice with roasted carrot, cauliflower, green beans and peas, fried onions, mint; (3) biryani agneau: a green bowl of spiced rice with pieces of roasted marinated lamb on top, fried onions, mint and coriander; (4) biryani crevettes: a green bowl of golden spiced rice topped with pink-orange marinated prawns, lime wedge, coriander; (5) naan nature: a plain round-teardrop naan with charred blisters on a steel plate, one corner folded; (6) naan à l'ail: a naan brushed with butter, covered in chopped garlic and green coriander, charred blisters, on a steel plate. Absolutely no text, no letters, no logos, no printed packaging, no hands, no people. Original images, not copies of any brand's photos.
